Everett Animal Services operates the Everett Animal Shelter and provides animal control services and pet licensing for the City of Everett in Washington state.

The Everett Animal Shelter accepts approximately 5000 animals each year to our state-of-the-art facility. Shelter staff and volunteers work hard to improve the health, safety and happiness of pets waiting to find or reunite with loving families.

Learn more: everettwa.gov/animals
